title: The alley in sleet
logline: The alley in sleet, the beer sign's puddle iced, the garage window lit. No figure. February of the first year: the strip's weather without the strip.

panels.composition: A gravel alley in sleet with a beer sign's neon reflected in a puddle skinned with ice, a small lit garage window, no one.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a gravel alley in sleet with a tavern's neon beer sign reflected in an ice-skinned puddle and a small lit garage window, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
